same_input_errors.caption: Mean displacement error on each original trajectory, evaluated at identical post-ready times and with the same original accepted voters. Each row uses one recorded episode; columns after Recorded use evaluation truth to replace registration or remove per-agent bootstrap/point-rotation error before taking the coordinate median. They are not deployable estimators or new task outcomes. Rows are two reused far-field conditions under three historical arms, not six independent reliability trials.

residual_vs_motion_error.caption: Local registration readout error versus the accepted fit residual at predeclared first-post-ready, BRAKE, HOLD, final, and maximum-team-remainder probes. Only original actual voters are shown; all probe records are provided in CSV. Small residuals coexist with large rigid-motion errors. Points are correlated diagnostic observations, not independent experimental samples. The gate/trim set may differ at the evaluator true pose, so cross-pose residuals alone do not rank correspondence quality.
